requirements_summary: Customer: Fletcher Grid Systems (utility control center). Core needs: deterministic throughput for real-time operator chat and dispatcher reranking; embedding store for anomaly detection with <50ms read for cached queries. Strong data residency + audit + KMS. Wants dedicated pool w/ predictable cold-start behavior and predictable failover. Requesting SLA guardrails around uptime, credits, maintenance windows and fast incident response for sev1.
contract_notes:
Key negotiation points:
- Uptime: Fletcher pushing for 99.99% (goal). We propose 99.95% with 5x credits at p95 failure bands. Customer argues grid-control is safety-critical; legal insists on higher.
- Credit schedule: customer wants linear crediting from minute 0; Redwood proposed tiered credit schedule: 99.95-99.9 => 10% monthly credit; 99.9-99.0 => 30%; <99.0 => 100% plus option to terminate. Fletcher counters: wants faster credit and service-level buybacks for severe outages.
- Maintenance windows: customer wants rolling 1-hour quarterly maintenance windows with 30 days notice. Redwood standard is 2-hour monthly window with 72-hour notice and one emergency maintenance per year. Blocker: Fletcher's procurement insists maintenance cannot fall into operational peak hours (06:00-22:00 local) — needs guaranteed blackout window.
- Support / Response times: Fletcher requires Sev1 response within 15 minutes (phone+pager) and resolution SLA of 4 hours for mission-critical incidents. Redwood standard: 1-hour on-call ack, 8-hour target for resolution. SER escalation: propose premium enterprise support add-on for 15-min ack and 4-hour target.
- Throughput guarantees: contract to specify reserved GPU equivalents (8x A100 v4 baseline, plus 2 hot standby) and a burst policy up to 12x for short spikes. Need to codify token/sec guarantees and model variants allowed for fallback.
- Fallbacks & routing: Fletcher requires automatic fallback to quantized variant on capacity pressure; wants no more than 5% degradation in output quality. Technical team to define compatible model variants and evaluation metric (reranking NDCG delta <0.02).
- Security & compliance: Data residency clause insists logs/audit data kept in-region (NA) for 90 days. HSM integration for keys; SOC2 report and ISO27001 cert copies required before final sign.
- Pricing: committed monthly spend with discount tiers; customer pushing for termination rights if uptime < 99.5% for two consecutive months. Redwood pushing for cure period and remediation plan instead of immediate termination.
Quote from CTO: "We cannot accept regular 2-hour maintenance windows during our day ops. Any downtime directly affects grid stability and regulator KPIs."
Sales posture: prioritize dedicated + enterprise support add-on; propose 6 month pilot with hard SLOs and automatic rollback to hosted fallback if obligations not met.
